scientific_integrity: An explicit proof and reproducible exact finite checks accompany the result; finite tests are not substituted for the infinite-dimensional argument. The identification of prior coverage is qualified, not a certification of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats positive reflection-invariant measures compactly supported inside (0,1) and missing 1/2; it proves a necessary support condition, not sufficiency or spectral classification. For general measures the exponential rate is universal but the multiplicative prefactor is not. Independent validation and exhaustive priority review are not performed.
title: A sharp midpoint-support obstruction to positivity of generalized Hilbert matrices
